setup.title: 32 parts of the frame weigh nothing
setup.why: base, body_top, depth_camera_front_lower_camera_parent, depth_camera_front_lower_depth_frame, depth_camera_front_lower_depth_optical_frame, depth_camera_front_upper_camera_parent (and more) came out of the URDF with zero mass, so your weight total is wrong by however much they really weigh.
setup.snippet: # in your URDF, give each link a real <mass value="..."/>

setup.title: No power rails declared
setup.why: Until rails exist I can't tell you whether your parts overload them — the check that finds most real build defects.
setup.snippet:
topology:
  rails:
    - id: rail.5v
      voltage: {value: 5.0, unit: V}
      capacity: {value: 15.6, unit: W}
      upstream: battery
      efficiency: 0.9

setup.title: No cables declared
setup.why: Without buses I can't check bandwidth or spot two devices claiming the same address.
setup.snippet:
topology:
  buses:
    - id: bus.can.main
      kind: can
      host: flight-controller
      bitrate: 1000000

setup.title: No parts declared
setup.why: The lockfile knows the frame but not what's bolted to it, so almost nothing can be checked yet.

setup.title: No limits set
setup.why: Budgets are the lines you don't want to cross — rail power, total weight, runtime. Without them there's nothing to fail against.
setup.snippet:
budgets:
  - id: bud.power.5v
    kind: rail_power
    rail: rail.5v
    limit: {value: 15.6, unit: W}
